title: The lockstep guard in reminder-v2-concurrency.test.ts has no test showing it fire
evidence: app/lib/reminder-v2-concurrency.test.ts lockstep() throws when the waiting queries differ from the live callers, but no test proves it. A pin: a caller that awaits a non-table timer first must make lockstep reject /round 0: waiting a, running a,b/. Test harness only; no production code involved
